assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional (official_boundary=false, provisional_rough precision) derived from the public announcement text, area constraints and road names; they are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All area-based metrics are calculated on provisional geometry; official polygon release requires full regeneration and recalculation of layers, metrics, figures and drawings.

assumptions.statement: Existing buildings, land ownership, rail alignments, river blue lines and heritage protection ranges are represented only as low-confidence analysis helpers or conceptual blocks; they need official survey verification.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish and constraint statements are conceptual and must not be treated as statutory conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Event participation, scenario usage, talent density and international communication performance indicators require future operation data; no operational performance is claimed today.
assumptions.impact: Performance indicators remain monitoring targets; they are not evidence of implemented activities.

assumptions.statement: Rail corridor and river blue line references in constraints.geojson are schematic only, marked analysis_helper with low confidence; official alignment data was not publicly available.
assumptions.impact: Station-city and blue-green integration concepts may shift once official alignments are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenario cards, test scenarios and event operations are conceptual design suggestions subject to data-minimization, human-review and authorization rules; they are not approved deployments.
assumptions.impact: Scenario privacy boundaries and review mechanisms are design commitments, not operating guarantees.
